title: Replace sync bootstrap with async staged model loader and tokenizer warm-up API
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Our current model bootstrap path performs synchronous weight deserialization and tokenizer initialization during endpoint startup. This causes long cold-start tails for large sharded checkpoints and blocks autoscaler actions. Proposal: Implement an async staged loader that separates (1) metadata manifest/weight index validation, (2) lightweight parameter map allocation, (3) background weight deserialization in prioritized micro-batches, and (4) KV cache population. Introduce a tokenizer warm-up API that lets the serving runtime request a prioritized tokenization pass for top-N prompt templates for a model, warming internal caches and pre-building common token sequences. Goals are to reduce p99 cold-start latency, improve availability during concurrent rollouts, and enable graceful degraded throughput while background load completes.
acceptance_criteria: Cold-start p99 for resnet-style 70B sharded checkpoints drops by >= 35% on average in perf lab
Model instances transition to READY state immediately after manifest validation with limited 'loading' throughput available (no 30s+ blocking calls)
Tokenizer warm-up reduces first-token latency for top-10 customer prompts by >= 25% in integration harness
No customer-facing errors introduced during canary rollout; fallback path to synchronous bootstrap for failures is exercised and documented
A migration guide and compatibility shim exist so Dedicated/Private customers can opt-in to new staged loader
rollout_plan: Feature branch with runtime flag 'staged_loader_v1' behind config
Merge behind feature flag and deploy to perf lab; run automated perf suite across common checkpoints
Canary rollout to 5% of hosted API traffic with verbose tracing and token-level cost telemetry
Increase canary to 25% after 48h of stable metrics, then 100% in 1 week pending no regressions
Offer Dedicated teams an opt-in cluster config and Private deployment bundle for initial testing
testing_plan: Unit tests for staged state transitions and failure injection (timeouts, disk read errors)
Integration tests exercising tokenizer warm-up API with recorded customer prompts
Perf lab runs for 8GB/16GB/32GB GPU shapes with synthetic concurrency profiles
Chaos test: kill background weight loader mid-deserialization and assert graceful degraded throughput and automatic retry
E2E smoke against Console rollouts dashboard metrics (latency, error-rate, load-duration)
Compatibility test matrix: legacy checkpoints, sharded formats v1..v3, quantized shards
